name: Cone of Cold
summary: Unleashes a 60-foot Cone of cold air that deals Cold damage.

m.text: a small crystal or glass cone

stats.effect: You unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot {ref:glossary/cone} originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.
